shell_commands:
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch
git diff origin/main...HEAD -- src/index.ts src/transport/ws/validation.ts src/transport/ws/messageHandler.ts src/transport/ws/sender.ts src/transport/createServer.ts
git log -3 --oneline
sed -n '1,150p' src/index.ts
sed -n '1,180p' src/transport/ws/validation.ts
sed -n '1,220p' src/transport/ws/messageHandler.ts
sed -n '1,220p' src/infrastructure/stores/mongo/optionalPeers.test.ts
sed -n '1,200p' package.json"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"specs/.+#|validated by|createMessageHandler|listing sessions failed|setLogger\" src specs .lore/test-commands.yml | head -240
sed -n '1,260p' .lore/test-commands.yml
sed -n '1,260p' specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md
sed -n '1,260p' specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md
rg --files src/transport/ws | sort"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,130p' src/transport/ws/validation.test.ts
sed -n '1,180p' src/transport/ws/messageHandler.test.ts
sed -n '1,230p' src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts
sed -n '1,80p' .lore/test-commands.yml
rg -n \""'^## |''^### " specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "timeout 300 node --experimental-vm-modules node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js --runTestsByPath src/transport/ws/messageHandler.test.ts --runInBand -t '"'^the websocket message handler dispatch logs a session list failure with the authenticated user and active session$'"'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '135,190p' specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md
sed -n '315,380p' specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md
sed -n '1,18p' specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md
git diff --check
git diff --stat"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "npx prettier --write .lore/dod.md src/index.ts src/transport/ws/validation.ts src/transport/ws/messageHandler.ts src/transport/ws/messageHandler.test.ts specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md
node scripts/check-spec-anchor-names.mjs --fix specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md
timeout 300 node --experimental-vm-modules node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js --runTestsByPath src/transport/ws/messageHandler.test.ts --runInBand -t '"'^the websocket message handler dispatch logs a session list failure with the authenticated user and active session$'"'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git diff --check
git status --short
git diff -- src/index.ts src/transport/ws/validation.ts src/transport/ws/messageHandler.ts src/transport/ws/messageHandler.test.ts .lore/dod.md
git diff -- specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md | sed -n '1,280p'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "npx prettier --write src/transport/ws/validation.ts
git diff --check
git status --short
git diff -- src/transport/ws/validation.ts
sed -n '96,116p' src/transport/ws/messageHandler.test.ts
sed -n '365,395p' specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md src/index.ts src/transport/ws/messageHandler.test.ts src/transport/ws/messageHandler.ts src/transport/ws/validation.ts && git commit -m "docs(transport): specify session list frames" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status --short --branch'
